result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and paved sidewalks adjacent to a wooded area. However, the crossing lacks active traffic control or physical speed-calming measures, potentially exposing pedestrians to uncontrolled vehicle flow.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a two-lane road without the protection of a stop sign or traffic signal for through traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side corner near the fire hydrant

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a raised crosswalk to physically slow down approaching vehicles and increase pedestrian prominence.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a residential or utility-adjacent street with a narrow concrete sidewalk that terminates at the roadway without any marked crossing or curb ramps. The environment lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as lighting, signage, or pavement markings, leaving pedestrians vulnerable when transitioning to the roadway.

hazards.name: Missing crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk or signage where the sidewalk meets the road, providing no guidance for pedestrians or drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground where the sidewalk meets the asphalt

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb, creating a significant barrier for people with disabilities or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of the sidewalk on the right

hazards.name: Sight line obstructions
hazards.description: Mature trees and utility poles near the road edge may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the sidewalk path

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a zebra-style marked crosswalk to clearly define the pedestrian path across the roadway.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct sloped curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the crossing is accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime and low-light conditions.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a narrow sidewalk and mature trees providing a buffer from the roadway. However, the environment lacks essential safety features such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and street lighting, which limits accessibility and pedestrian protection.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk terminates at the road edge without a sloped ramp, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Where the sidewalk meets the road edge in the foreground

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked crossing area for pedestrians to traverse the two-lane roadway safely.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree trunk and low-hanging branches near the road edge may partially block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Large tree on the left side of the road

interventions.title: Install ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct sloped curb ramps with tactile warning surfaces at the sidewalk terminus to ensure an accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Apply continental-style pavement markings to clearly define the pedestrian crossing zone and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Improve Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting to enhance visibility and safety for people walking during nighttime hours.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with marked continental crosswalks and a sidewalk on at least one side. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the lack of visible traffic control signs or signals for the main roadway may increase risk for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: There are no visible stop signs or traffic signals for the main road, which may lead to higher vehicle speeds and failure to yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection of the two roads.

interventions.title: All-Way Stop Control
